args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in production following release. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up required: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 failed health checks

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: The latest production deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy; the most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed and was verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with a low error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need for a root-cause investigation before re-deploying.
